notes.title: Public Alpha Build 3.3.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changelog :[/b][/h1]

Optimized performance of various locations and overall
Generals bugs fix
Addition of GCPR (globally collectable persistent resources)
Add new places
Add new mob (Poison Spider)
Add spawning Places for mob
Add new difficulty for mobs ( Tier D C B A S)
Overhaul of certain huds (Ui + Craft + Shop) and the overall user experience
New step sound (more imersive)
Correction of some sound bugs
Zone bug fixed
Soul world performance issue corrected
Addition of an impertinent ambient sound
Added some map details
Complete extension of human territory (multiple new biomes)
New hamlet
New NPCs (merchant and regular)
Secret chests on the map up to 30!
Several new tracks added
Fixed gift bug
Increased gift power (approx. X1.5 - X2.5 vs. before)
Reworked water shader
Fixed part of map with colision bug
Night is brighter now
Air combo bug fixed
Fixed a few interaction bugs

[h1]Note[/h1]

[b]This version is equivalent of paid Silver version 3.3 release in 01 January 2024

In order to refresh some keyboard settings to avoid new hud probleme please delete :"C:\Users\[YourUserName]\AppData\Local\LivingsDollsRebirth\Saved\SaveGames\Settings\MyOptions.sav"[/b]
